entry.title: Thanatos Coursework
entry.content: During my second semester of the first year of uni, I worked on a 2D platformer along with some of my classmates. I created the pitch, and a large part of the design document, as well as creating and programming the sound effects & music in the game.

entry.title: Wave FPS design document
entry.content: We are almost finished with out game design document for the group coursework! The game is going to be a wave shooter where enemies from different times and eras will come for you in endless waves. The game is going well so far.
